approved: Fair Work Amendment (Improving National Employment Standards) Bill 2018

The speaker introduced the Fair Work Amendment (Improving National Employment Standards) Bill 2017, which would provide all employees with 10 days of paid family and domestic violence leave per year, citing that one in six women experience such violence, 44 women died from it last year, and it costs an average of $18,000 and 141 hours to escape an abusive relationship.
